Name: Ruby Rose portraits for Emily
Author: Winters381
Description:
Replaces Emily's portrait with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys[/url]' style portraits, with a volume one design.

These are very much intended to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25634954]wolffang719[/url]'s 'Emily as Ruby Rose' character sprites, which are rad.
I'm not an artist, just a guy with paint.net installed, so I pretty much recoloured these from the original talkohlooeys' style as you can likely tell by the... interesting job of the red highlights.
There's also a bit of amateur artwork with her clothes and hat on the winter outfit.

I'm pretty sure the winter portraits don't quite match wolffang719's sprites, but I really wanted to use Ruby's outfit for Ice Queendom (without the goggles) and thought the plain hood would be a bit visually boring. I'd probably also do a worse job because I wouldn't get the hoodie right (still not an artist).


I made this because I pretty much exclusively use talkohlooeys' portraits, and I really wanted the art to match the sprite from wolffang719's mod.


It's only for use via portraiture (and therefore requires portraiture), so it's just the raw images; just unzip the files into your folder structure as below.

Stardew Valley>Mods>Portraiture>Portraits>(folder with any other portraits you intend to use this one with - alternatively, just a new folder with any name)


Big shoutout to the original authors' mods, which are here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5472]Emily as Ruby Rose (From RWBY)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url]

You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/144159063]anniekureko[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11726]Custom NPC Name - Mobile[/url] to change emily's name to Ruby, if you like. Not required, though.
There's probably a better way to do this, but if there is, I don't know, and i'm not too worried: because this works fine.
